app.title: Discipline Diary
app.subtitle: Keep track of your daily habits

dashboard.welcomeDescription: This app helps you build habits: mark each daily habit as done or missed, log a penalty for days you miss, and watch your streaks and completion rate get calculated and shown right here automatically. You haven't added any tasks yet — create your first one to get started.
